description: Installs Apple's San Francisco fonts and makes them the system sans and monospace, so Chromium renders pages with them.
name: San Francisco Font

mono.description: Install SF Mono and resolve monospace, ui-monospace, Menlo, SFMono-Regular and Courier New to it.

webSafeSans.description: Also resolve Arial, Helvetica, Helvetica Neue, Segoe UI and Roboto to SF Pro. Required for the CSS sans-serif generic to be San Francisco in Chromium, which asks fontconfig for Arial rather than for sans-serif.
